category.name: Code execution sandboxes
category.description: Isolated cloud environments where an agent can run code, shells and whole dev environments safely.

entries.name: Cloudflare Sandbox SDK
entries.auth_hint: Cloudflare API token to deploy the Worker; the sandbox itself is reached through your own deployed Worker route
entries.free_tier: requires Workers Paid plan ($5/mo) for Containers; no free tier for container-backed sandboxes
entries.desc_en: Deploy a Cloudflare Worker embedding this SDK to run untrusted code in per-request container sandboxes.
entries.notes: Not a hosted API called directly with a key — you build and deploy your own Worker using the SDK on top of Cloudflare Containers/Durable Objects.

entries.name: CodeSandbox SDK
entries.auth_hint: CSB_API_KEY env var, passed to the CodeSandbox() SDK constructor
entries.free_tier: Free plan: 400 VM credits/mo (~40 Nano-VM hrs), up to 10 concurrent VMs
entries.desc_en: Programmatically create, resume, and control cloud VM sandboxes to run and preview AI-written code.
entries.notes: Also powers Together AI's white-labeled 'Code Sandbox' product; unofficial community MCP wrappers exist but none vendor-maintained.

entries.name: Daytona
entries.free_tier: $200 free compute credit + 5GB storage, no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Create elastic remote sandboxes via SDK/API to run AI-generated code with sub-second startup.
entries.notes: Billed per second; supports sandbox snapshots and preview URLs for web apps.

entries.name: E2B
entries.auth_hint: E2B_API_KEY env var / Authorization Bearer or X-API-Key header
entries.free_tier: free Hobby tier with limited sandbox hours, then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Spin up isolated Firecracker cloud sandboxes via SDK/REST to execute AI-generated code and return results.
entries.notes: Sandboxes auto-expire after a configurable timeout (default ~5 min); used by many agent frameworks (OpenHands, etc.).

entries.name: Judge0
entries.auth_hint: X-Auth-Token header (self-hosted, if enabled) or X-RapidAPI-Key (RapidAPI-hosted); can run with none if self-hosted unauthenticated
entries.free_tier: RapidAPI free Basic plan (rate-limited); self-host free & open-source (GPLv3)
entries.desc_en: Submit source code and stdin via REST to compile/run it in 60+ languages and poll for the result.
entries.notes: Built for compile-run-compare judging (like competitive programming), not long-lived interactive agent sandboxes; self-hosting recommended for production agent use.

entries.name: Modal
entries.desc_en: Programmatically launch serverless sandboxes, optionally with GPUs, to execute untrusted or agent code.
entries.notes: Sandbox compute billed separately from regular function compute (~$0.14/vCPU-hr); Python SDK is most mature/complete.

entries.name: Piston
entries.auth_hint: no key needed for the public instance (rate-limited)
entries.free_tier: free, no key, public instance rate-limited (~5 req/sec); self-host for unlimited/production use
entries.desc_en: Call a free public REST API to compile and run code in 70+ languages inside isolated containers.
entries.notes: The public emkc.org instance is for low-volume/non-commercial use; widely used by Discord/Slack bots and agents; self-host via Docker for heavier agent workloads.

entries.name: Riza
entries.free_tier: free for side projects/low usage, then usage-based pricing
entries.desc_en: Call a REST API to execute untrusted Python/JS/Ruby/PHP code in sandboxes that start in under 10ms.
entries.notes: Also supports saving reusable 'tools' (functions) via a Tools API for repeated agent calls.

entries.name: Runloop
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <RUNLOOP_API_KEY> (auto-loaded from RUNLOOP_API_KEY env var)
entries.free_tier: $50 free credits on signup, then usage-based ($0.108/CPU-hr, $0.0252/GB-hr)
entries.desc_en: Create, snapshot, suspend/resume, and run commands in Linux Devboxes via API/SDK for agent coding tasks.
entries.notes: Includes an 'MCP Hub' feature letting Devboxes connect outward to other MCP tool servers; no confirmed official vendor MCP server exposing Runloop itself.

entries.name: Vercel Sandbox
entries.auth_hint: VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN (recommended, auto on Vercel) or VERCEL_TOKEN Bearer + team/project IDs
entries.free_tier: usage included on Hobby plan, otherwise usage-based on Pro/Enterprise
entries.desc_en: Boot ephemeral Firecracker microVMs via SDK/REST to run agent- or AI-generated code and shell commands.
entries.notes: Pricing = active CPU + provisioned memory + per Sandbox.create() call + data transfer; 32GB ephemeral NVMe per sandbox.
